title: RiskScore
description: Schema for ML risk scores produced by M5 (ML Risk-Scoring Engine) and consumed by M2 (Policy Enforcement) and M3 (Automated Response). Version 1.0 – frozen for Phase 1.

session_id.description: Session identifier this score applies to.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the score was computed.

score.description: Continuous risk score. 0.0 = no observed risk; 1.0 = maximum risk. Four decimal places recommended.

confidence.description: Model confidence in this score estimate. Used by M2 to weight the decision.

top_features.description: Top contributing features ranked by absolute contribution (descending). Required for auditability.

name.description: Feature name as used by the ML model.

contribution.description: Absolute SHAP-style contribution of this feature to the risk score.

model_version.description: Identifier of the model version that produced this score (e.g. 'stub-v1.0', 'isolation-forest-v2.1').
